messages:
jordan: noticed an unexpected uptick in billed tokens routed to 'preview' after the route-price tweak at 06:00. chart in console shows a step increase for a small tenant cohort. anyone tracking ingest anomalies?

mia: saw same. running a narrow query: `SELECT count(1), sum(tokens) FROM ingest.raw WHERE route='preview' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T06:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-10T06:10:00Z' GROUP BY retry_count` — retry_count>0 buckets are ~4x higher tokens.

sam: interesting. could retries be losing promo metadata on the client proxy retry path? last time we had a header-copy regression it hit the enrich join.

lee: FYI console invoice-preview currently computes price by joining aggregation.events -> pricing via route_hint. If route_hint is NULL we apply list_price. That's probably why previews diverge from later corrected invoices.

ops: deploy-bot: sidecar-proxy v2.14.1 rolled to canary-edge-3 at 05:58 UTC, rollout 06:02. No failing healthchecks reported.

mia: I pulled raw request samples. snippet: `{ "route": "preview", "retry_count": 1, "headers": {"X-Route": "preview"}, "client": "proxy-proto-1" }` — missing X-Route-Hint in all these.

jordan: two remediation options: (A) rollback sidecar canary; (B) do an enrichment in the ingest pipeline that backfills route_hint using tenant->promo mapping when retry_count>0. Which is lower risk?

sam: (B) is lower blast radius but needs careful idempotency. Enrichment should only run when route='preview' AND route_hint IS NULL AND retry_count>0. We'll log a tombstone to avoid double-applying.

lee: UX ask: add a small orange "derived" badge on invoice preview rows where pricing came from best-effort enrichment instead of explicit header. Also show a link to the raw event so support can audit.

mia: I'll prototype the enrichment transformation. Rough CPU impact: ~0.03ms per event x peak preview QPS (~2k) = ~60ms CPU per second, trivial. But Kafka consumer lag might increase; will add metric `enrich.preview.backfilled` and a gauge for added processing time.

billing-bot: Finance note: retrocomputing promos will create invoice adjustments. Please attach an estimate of total token volume affected and projected USD impact before making mass corrections.

jordan: good point. @mia include a query to compute affected_token_sum and sample tenant list. We'll triage which tenants need outreach vs silent adjustment.

ops: if we go enrichment-only, recommend a short canary in preview pipeline (5m) and a throttled replay of backfill. If rollback chosen, be aware dedicated customers on canary-edge-3 might see transient connection resets.

sam: also adding a tiny e2e test to our routing-suite that calls the proxy with retry semantics and asserts X-Route-Hint persists. I'll open a PR.

mia: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infer/ingest@pr/345 . includes unit + integration test, metric instrumentation, and the tombstone header. Putting on review.

lee: I'll mock up the console badge + raw-event link as a small product card. We should also add a "confidence" tooltip that explains enrichment rules.

jordan: timeline: patch + canary for enrichment in 2 hours, run replay for 24h window if green. Ops will prep rollback playbook in parallel. Billing: estimate due before replay. Keep this thread updated. :pray:
